create_footprint_mask: create a Footprint object and call get_mask to generate a 2D collision mask tensor
create_rotated_footprint_mask: create a Footprint object and call get_rotated_mask to generate a rotated collision mask tensor
subclass_robotmodel: subclass RobotModel to implement a custom robot with get_dof, set_config, and get_footprint methods
set_robot_config: call set_config on a RobotModel subclass instance to position the robot for bullet planning
attach_camera_to_head: call set_camera_to_head on a RobotModel subclass to mount a bullet camera on the robot head
